summary: St. Mary's, St. Anthony's and St. Margaret's (the NCSM cluster). The bulletin has no schedule box, only dated intentions: weekend and weekday Masses, Saturday and Tuesday-Friday Confession and a Friday Adoration hour repeat in all five bulletins, and the joint website ncsmcatholic.org (named in the newest bulletin) matches them. St. Lawrence's Saturday Mass and the Newman Center's Sunday Mass come from that website only. Open: a website-only First Saturday 9:30 AM Mass.
